description: Documentation for the class PageAssertions and its methods, providing assertion utilities for testing page states using Playwright across multiple programming languages.

classes.name: PageAssertions
classes.description: Provides assertion methods to verify various states and properties of a Playwright Page in tests, supporting multiple programming languages and features like URL, title, and visual screenshot assertions.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Makes the assertion check for the opposite condition, e.g., asserting that a page URL does not contain a specific string.

methods.name: NotToHaveTitle
methods.description: Asserts that the page title does not match the given string or regular expression. Supports optional timeout configuration.

methods.name: NotToHaveURL
methods.description: Asserts that the page URL does not match the given string, regular expression, or predicate function. Supports options like ignoreCase and timeout.

methods.name: toHaveScreenshot
methods.description: Asserts that the page's screenshot matches a baseline image, optionally with various customization options such as clip, mask, scale, etc. Supports usage in Playwright test runner only.

methods.name: toHaveTitle
methods.description: Asserts that the page title matches the expected string or pattern. Supports both async and sync usage across languages.

methods.name: toHaveURL
methods.description: Asserts that the page URL matches the expected string, regular expression, or predicate. Supports options like ignoreCase, timeout, etc.
